tone.target: jangly clean Vox/Fender crunch with slight tremolo-like shimmer
tone.profile: jangly clean Vox/Fender crunch with slight tremolo-like shimmer
tone.summary: A classic chimey rhythm tone using a US Deluxe amp model, paired with single-coil character, light compression for definition, and spring reverb for vintage depth.

rig.name: Tom Petty - Here Comes My Girl - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean tones.

blocks.purpose: Slightly lift the signal and add definition for tight strumming.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of Comp to maintain maximum brightness, as requested by 'bright chime'.

blocks.purpose: Provide clean-to-edge breakup and mild grit without heavy fuzz.
blocks.gap: Red Haze offers a gentle, vintage overdrive suitable for the 'Vox/Fender crunch' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, clean character of a Fender/Vox-style combo.
blocks.gap: None. US Deluxe is ideal for classic American chime tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, focused sound suitable for rhythm guitar.
blocks.gap: None. Matches the 2x12 clue and complements the US Deluxe model.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the 'bright chime' and cut any muddiness from the signal chain.
blocks.gap: Used to fine-tune the high end, emphasizing clarity over raw power.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No wah effect is required for this rhythm tone.
blocks.gap: The target sound does not require a sweeping filter.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle 'shimmer' effect, mimicking the requested tremolo-like shimmer without being distracting.
blocks.gap: Tremolo is used instead of Chorus/Vibrato to achieve the specified shimmering quality.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and space to the rhythm without sounding busy.
blocks.gap: Kept very minimal (low feedback/level) so it doesn't interfere with the tight strumming feel.

blocks.purpose: Provide the requested 'light room reverb' and vintage ambience.
blocks.gap: None. Room reverb is perfect for a natural, non-metallic shimmer.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and overall vintage depth by swapping the default IR for a classic Vox-style speaker.
